I need to decide whether to accept, reject, or counter the trade offer from p2.

The offer is for $300 cash in exchange for both utilities. p2 is nearly broke and owns heavily mortgaged properties with houses on Park Place and Boardwalk. I have a small cash buffer and only one property.

This offer is at face value. I previously rejected a similar utilities trade at $400. Utilities are poor income. I should not give p2 cash to fund their builds. My priority is buying St. James, Baltic, and Pacific.

The $300 would let p2 buy another house on the dark blues. Boardwalk with three houses would cost $1400 in rent. That is too dangerous.

With $357, p2 could buy one house on Park Place. That would cost $200 and leave $157. They cannot afford two houses.

One more house on the dark blues would make Park Place rent $500 or Boardwalk rent $1400. That is bankruptcy territory.

My $1075 cash is my survival buffer and buying power. I can buy St. James for $180, Baltic for $60, and Pacific for $300. Pennsylvania Avenue is owned by p1. The yellows are unowned.
